div.head: Hn 21
div.ab: De generibus causarum. Sunt etiam, ut diximus, quedam genera causarum premissa singularitate licentius expedita, in quarum emendacionibus rex particulariter communicat, ubicunque fiant, in diuinis uel secularibus, super regios et ecclesiasticos et baronum homines et acephalos et pauperes, siue socnam totaliter habeat uel particulariter: ex quibus sunt adulterium; homicidium in ecclesia factum; infraccio pacis uel ordinis uel christianitatis uel legalitatis, si cogi oporteat per mundanam potestatem, ut rectum fiat.

div.ab: Of the kinds of cases. There are also, as we have said, certain kinds of cases, dealt with more freely than the singularity set out above [?], in whose compensations the king shares in part, wherever they happen, in divine or secular [matters], over the king's and the church's and the barons' men and masterless men and the poor, whether he has the soke wholly or in part: among which are adultery; homicide done in a church; breach of the peace or of [holy] orders or of Christianity or of lawfulness, if it is necessary to compel by worldly power that right be done.
